newsitem.title: USA: Metrocall, Page America revise pact.
newsitem.headline: Metrocall, Page America revise pact.

text.p: Metrocall Inc and Page America Group Inc said Friday they have revised their asset purchase agreement.

Under the restructured pact, Metrocall will acquire Page America for $25 million in cash, $15 million in Metrocall junior preferred stock, 830,333 shares of Metrocall common stock, and an additional $15 million in common stock or common stock equivalents.
The stock portion is subject to adjustment based on changes in Page America's working capital deficit and decreases in service revenue below certain threshold levels.
Metrocall retains the option to substitute cash at closing for all or a portion of the equity securities that are part of the consideration.

The revised terms replace an April 1996 agreement under which Metrocall would have paid up to $78.5 million for Page America's assets, consisting of $55 million in cash and common stock then valued at up to $23.5 million, subject to certain adjustments.

The revised terms reflect purchase price adjustments under the original contract based on Page America's third-quarter 1996 results, and the current price of Metrocall's common shares, Metrocall said.
The terms provide Metrocall financial flexibility in choosing the mix of consideration to be paid for Page America's assets, the company said.

It added that in order to provide sufficient shares for these and prior transactions, Metrocall's stockholders will be asked at the annual meeting scheduled for May 7 to approve an increase in Metrocall's authorized common shares to 60 million.
It said shareholders representing approximately 38.2 percent of the outstanding shares have agreed to vote in favor of this proposal and the convertibility of the junior preferred stock, it said.
The transaction is subject to approval by the stockholders of Page America and other standard closing conditions, it said.
